item.title: Abbreviated code
item.description:
Abbreviated code

Abbreviated code is Fortran-like language within an NM-TRAN control stream that is used to specify a model. The $PRED, $PK, $ERROR, $DES, $AES, $AESINITIAL, $TOL, $MIX, and $INFN records each initiates a block of abbreviated code. Such a block ends with either the appearance of another record(beginning with a "$"), or end of the control stream. The code blocks in NONMEM 7.2+ versions are case-insensitive.

Comments

Semicolon character ";" marks the beginning of comments so that the rest of the line is ignored.

item.title: Output
item.description:
Output files and quantities

NM-TRAN output files

NM-TRAN produces several output files, some of which are input files to NONMEM itself.

File name Relevant portion of NM-TRAN inputs How file is used
FCON All NONMEM (control stream)
FDATA Data file, $DATA, $INPUT NONMEM (data file)
FSTREAM Filenames from $DATA,$MSFI, $MSFO, $TABLE NONMEM (file control stream)
FSUBS Abbreviated code Generated FORTRAN subroutines
FREPORT $SUBROUTINES Input to whatever generates the commands that create the NONMEM executable. See also $SUBROUTINES.
FORIG Abbreviated code, $ABBR When $ABBR REPLACE is used,this file contains the original abbreviated code.
FREPL Abbreviated code, $ABBR When $ABBR REPLACE is used, this file contains the postreplacement abbreviated code.
FWORK Data file NM-TRAN (work file)
FWARN All Warning and informational messages.
FSIZES Abbreviated code, $THETA, $OMEGA, $SIGMA,$SIZES, SIZES.f90 Dynamic array sizes for NONMEM. The file is for user consumption only. SUBROUTINE FSIZESR in FSUBS is what is actually used during the NONMEM run.
prsizes Abbreviated code, $THETA, $OMEGA, $SIGMA, $SIZES, SIZES.f90 Static array sizes for PREDPP

With NONMEM 7, files FSUBS2 and FSUBS_MU are used by NMTRAN as work files during the creation of FSUBS.
